scope: Provider-neutral deterministic provenance, accepted-baseline lifecycle, validated incremental reconciliation, scheduled daily execution, query and static cookbook foundation
decisions: Path plus content hash and Git identity is the universal artifact revision
Semantic versions are declared only when meaningful
AI may interpret candidate knowledge but does not own validation truth
Operations Scheduler owns the active 06:00 Estate-local job
Baseline advancement is an explicit audited acceptance action
Invalid packets never suppress undeclared-change detection
Authored Mermaid is rendered to deterministic inline SVG without network dependencies
limitations: Running installation provenance is not universal
Reasoned maintenance capability integration is optional future Stage 2 work
